# Showhow Copilot instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` for product boundaries and engineering conventions. For an
approved cloud ticket, follow `.github/skills/overnight-ticket/SKILL.md`.

The cloud lane implements a single approved scope and returns a tested PR for
human merge. Its independent reviewer is Copilot code review; the local Bedar
Loop's Herdr, Codex, OpenCode and launchd procedures do not run in this lane.
Review sessions assess the supplied commit and report findings; they do not
implement the ticket.
